role: Centralized UTC timestamp provider for Co-Being to ensure consistent timezone-aware datetimes across all modules.
detail: Single-function module exporting utc_now() which returns the current UTC datetime with tzinfo=UTC. Replaces seven previously-duplicated _utc_now() helpers scattered across Layer 3 modules. Uses datetime.now(UTC) from Python 3.11+ datetime module. No side effects. Designed to prevent timezone ambiguity when comparing timestamps across sessions or serializing to storage.
